In this Division— Dairy Food Safety Victoria means the Authority established by section 4 of the Dairy Act 2000 as in force immediately before the commencement day; transferred employee means a person whose employment is transferred to Safe Food Victoria under section 53.

On the commencement day— (a) Dairy Food Safety Victoria is abolished; and (b) any person holding office as a member of Dairy Food Safety Victoria ceases to hold office; and (c) any selection committee established under section 10 of the Dairy Act 2000 as in force immediately before the commencement day is dissolved; and (d) any person holding office as a member of a selection committee ceases to hold office; and (e) all property and rights that, immediately before the commencement day, were vested in Dairy Food Safety Victoria, vest in Safe Food Victoria; and (f) all liabilities of Dairy Food Safety Victoria existing immediately before the commencement day become liabilities of Safe Food Victoria; and (g) Safe Food Victoria is substituted as a party in any proceedings pending in any court or tribunal to which Dairy Food Safety Victoria was party immediately before the commencement day; and (h) Safe Food Victoria is substituted as a party to any contract or arrangement (including any administrative arrangement) entered into by or on behalf of Dairy Food Safety Victoria and in force immediately before the commencement day.

After Part IIIA of the Food Act 1984 insert— "Part IIIAB—Information or document production notices 19BD Definitions In this Part— required document means— (a) in relation to a notice under section 19BE(1) that requires the provision of a specified document, that document; and (b) in relation to a notice under section 19BE(1) that requires the provision of documents of a specified class, the documents belonging to that class; required information means— (a) in relation to a notice under section 19BE(1) that requires the provision of specified information, that information; and (b) in relation to a notice under section 19BE(1) that requires the provision of information of a specified class, the information belonging to that class. 19BE Power to give information or document production notice (1) Safe Food Victoria may give a written notice to a person requiring that person to provide Safe Food Victoria specified information or information of a specified class, or a specified document or documents of a specified class, if Safe Food Victoria determines that there are reasonable grounds to believe that— (a) the required information or required document is in that person's knowledge, possession, custody or control; and (b) the required information is, or the required document contains information that is, necessary— (i) for monitoring that person's or another person's compliance with a requirement imposed on that person under this Act; or (ii) for determining whether that person or another person has committed an offence under this Act; or (iii) for determining whether a risk to public health exists. (2) An information or document production notice must— (a) state the name of the person to whom the notice is given; and (b) specify the grounds on which the notice is given; and (c) specify what is to be provided or produced under the notice, being— (i) specified information; or (ii) a specified class of information; or (iii) a specified document; or (iv) a specified class of documents; and (d) specify the time period within which the person must comply with the notice; and (e) state that it is an offence to contravene the notice without reasonable excuse and that the maximum penalty is 25 penalty units for the first offence and 50 penalty units for a second or subsequent offence; and (f) state that a natural person to whom an information or document production notice is given— (i) may refuse or fail to provide required information if doing so would tend to incriminate the person; and (ii) must not refuse or fail to produce a required document on the basis that doing so would tend to incriminate the person. Penalty: For a first offence 25 penalty units, and for a second or subsequent offence 50 penalty units. 19BG Protection from liability for person giving information under an information or document production notice The giving of information in accordance with section 19BF does not— (a) make the person by whom it is given subject to any liability in respect of it; or (b) constitute a contravention of any other Act or law (including common law). 19BH Protection against self-incrimination (1) A natural person to whom an information or document production notice is given may refuse or fail to provide required information if doing so would tend to incriminate the person. (2) A natural person to whom an information or document production notice is given must not refuse or fail to produce a required document on the basis that doing so would tend to incriminate the person. 19BI Admissibility of document produced under information or document production notice A document produced by a natural person, under an information or document production notice, that would tend to incriminate the person is not admissible in evidence against the person in a proceeding unless— (a) the person is required by law to keep the document; or (b) the proceeding is in respect of false or misleading information included in the document.".
